notes: Tutorial-adjacent procedural beat. Fires when the player submits their first bill. Speaker: generic floor aide (unnamed, bureaucratic, slightly nervous — they are responsible for the paperwork and acutely aware of the clock). Purpose: orient the player to the committee process and introduce time pressure as a recurring game mechanic. One choice point: fast-track (Political Capital cost, accelerated timeline) vs patient route (no cost, full committee cycle). No faction effects. No ideology effects. Ends with 'first_bill_introduced' flag. voiceTag omitted — floor-aide has no archetype assignment yet. TODO(vex/OQ-F): Sol to confirm whether generic NPCs like 'floor-aide' require a voiceTag or whether the field is fully optional for non-seed characters. 'floor-aide' is a procedural NPC class, not a named character; no wiki entry needed. PC cost on fast-track option is an authoring placeholder — TODO(vex/OQ-G): confirm PC cost calibration with Sol once PC economy is balanced for M2.

open.speaker: floor-aide
open.text: Senator — sorry, do you have a moment? Your bill submission just went through. There are a few things I'm supposed to walk you through.

committee-intro.speaker: floor-aide
committee-intro.text: It goes to the relevant committee first. They schedule a markup session, amend it if they want to, then vote it to the floor — or they don't. That last part is more common than you'd think.

time-pressure.speaker: floor-aide
time-pressure.text: The calendar is the problem. The committee chair has sixteen other bills ahead of yours. Standard process takes three to five weeks. The session window closes in eight.

options.label: Fast-track it. I'll call in what I need to.
Standard process. Give it the full committee cycle.

fast-track-path.speaker: floor-aide
fast-track-path.text: Understood. I'll — yes. I'll flag it as priority routing. The committee staff will notice. Some of them will have opinions about that.

patient-path.speaker: floor-aide
patient-path.text: That's — yes, that's the correct answer, technically. I'll make sure the paperwork is complete. A clean submission helps with the committee staff.

exit.speaker: narrator
exit.text: The aide retreats into the hallway with the folder, already moving toward the next door.
